Yidi's Consulting | Senior Full-Stack Engineer | REMOTE (LATAM/EU time zones welcome) | Contract-to-hire | $40/hr | yidisconsulting.com

We're a 4-person boutique consulting shop in Albany, NY building custom web apps for healthcare, legal, and education clients. Looking for a senior engineer to work alongside the founder on production systems for clients.

Stack: Go (Echo, ENT), PostgreSQL, AWS, Cloudflare, Clerk, Alpine.js, Tailwind, Vite, Terraform. We have a proprietary ~1M-line Platform Foundation that anchors most projects.

You: Shipped real Go in production (not "willing to learn"). Comfortable across the stack. Opinions about migrations, RBAC, and not-overengineering. English fluent enough to talk directly with clients.

Process: Paid trial task → 3-month contract → conversion to long-term contractor. No middlemen, no platform markup.

Apply: hiring@yidisconsulting.com with a Go project you're proud of and a brief note on how you'd approach a vertical-slice task touching ENT, an Echo handler, and an Alpine component.
